initialization: ONLY the already sealed B0 minimum full measured objective endpoint; no ground truth or score reads
cost_scope: B0 plus Full-GN cumulative; no cold-start or independent blind claim
parameter_coordinates: all110 independent box-bounded physical material coordinates, optimized in public scaled coordinates
row_order: frequency, source, receiver; real stack Re(all complex rows), then Im(all rows), divided by sigma .01
cell_order: row-major ascending physical y, then x
shared_adjoint: 4 primal and16 receiver-adjoint RHS per frequency share the same LU; no per-parameter PDE solves
trial_acceptance: full original P3 cached-combined FEM objective with identical TV/spatial prior; strict decrease at alpha1,.5,.25
numerical_damping: initial .01; accepted ratio>.75 halves damping, ratio<.25 doubles; all rejected multiplies by10; not part of prior
endpoint_diagnostic: At most one extra endpoint full-J checkpoint after the last accepted step; no optimization step follows
stationarity: scaled projected-gradient infinity tolerance1e-4 is local only; other stops explicitly NONCONVERGED; no global-optimum claim
